# Third-party images used by the CI integration stacks, mirrored to ghcr.io/neicnordic/sda-ci-mirror.
#
# Format: <source>@sha256:<digest> <mirror tag>
# The digest is the top "Digest:" of `docker buildx imagetools inspect <image>`: the index, or the manifest
# for single-platform images. The copy keeps it unchanged (carbon copy, all platforms).
# Mirror tag: drop a registry prefix such as quay.io/, replace / with -, then -<tag>.
#   quay.io/ceph/vstart-cluster:19.2.6 -> ceph-vstart-cluster-19.2.6
# Floating tags are pinned to a concrete version tag with the same digest. If none exists, the source keeps
# :latest and the mirror tag is <name>-sha-<first 12 hex of the digest>.
#
# The workflow mirror_ci_images.yml copies each digest to ghcr.io/neicnordic/sda-ci-mirror:<mirror tag>
# when this file changes on main.
#
# Adding an image or a new version takes two PRs:
#   1. add the line here and merge; wait for the mirror workflow on main to succeed
#   2. point a compose file at the new mirror tag
# A new minor or major version gets a new mirror tag. Tags such as python:3.14-slim-trixie or golang:1.25-alpine
# move with patch releases; bumping such a line only changes its digest, which is only tested after merge.
#
# Nothing updates these images automatically (Dependabot does not read this file).
#
# Removing a line stops the copy but leaves the tag in the mirror, since older and hotfix branches may still
# pull it. To delete an image, an admin removes that version in the sda-ci-mirror package settings.
